matrix_name.name: bamboo cellulose
matrix_name.description: TEMPO-oxidized bamboo cellulose nanofibers (BCNF) used as the matrix in reduced sample rL1C20; described by the authors as a homogeneous film.

fillers.name: silver
fillers.description: Silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) generated in situ on BCNF (BCNF@AgNPs); loading in rL1C20 was not explicitly stated.

fillers.name: graphene oxide
fillers.description: Reduced graphene oxide (rGO) obtained after vitamin C reduction; sample code C20 indicates a total combined GO+MWCNT mass of 20 mg, but the individual rGO amount was not specified.

fillers.name: carbon nanotubes
fillers.description: Multi-walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs) in the conductive phase; sample code C20 indicates a total combined GO+MWCNT mass of 20 mg, but the individual MWCNT amount was not specified.
